noLegalMoves.text: The white pawn on b5 cannot move: every move it has would leave its own king attacked. The white pawn on b5 cannot capture the black pawn on c5 en passant (the special capture of a pawn that has just moved two squares, passing this one) by moving to c6: the capture would take both the white pawn on b5 and the black pawn on c5 off the fifth rank, opening a line along which the black rook on h5 would attack the white king on a5.
